visual_action: A static close-up shot of egg cartons in a grocery store refrigerated section. A price tag shows the cost is $10.49. Next to the price tag is a cutout sticker of Donald Trump pointing at the price with a speech bubble that says "I DID THAT!".

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: A sticker of him is shown on screen and the overlay text mentions "Trump promised prices would go down on day one".

on_screen_text.text: lol not these showing up in grocery stores after Trump promised prices would go down on day one 😂😂😂

spoken_summary: There is no speech or dialogue in the video, only music.
audio_music: A popular, confrontational hip-hop track ('Not Like Us' by Kendrick Lamar) plays throughout the clip, adding an edgy and modern feel to the political criticism.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static shot with no edits.
cultural_references: The video uses a version of the "I Did That!" sticker meme, which originally featured Joe Biden and was placed on gas pumps to blame him for high fuel prices. Here, it is repurposed with Donald Trump to blame him for high grocery prices.
The audio is the song "Not Like Us" by Kendrick Lamar.
central_claim: Donald Trump has failed on his promise to lower prices, as evidenced by the high cost of eggs in grocery stores.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump, blame him for high inflation and cost of living, and portray his promises as empty.
